That is absolutely NOT the case with Sea Pro. You would be hard pressed to find another saltwater worthy boat with MORE INNOVATION, MORE STANDARD FEATURES and INDUSTRY LEADING WARRANTY than a Sea Pro! Sea Pro is one of the fastest growing center console brands in the industry. The reason is simple… we spare no expense on the raw materials, hardware, and equipment that go into every feature filled and cleverly designed boat
